about: The Coeur d'Alene Resort runs its Journey to the North Pole cruises on Lake Coeur d'Alene from November 26 through January 3.
Each 40-minute cruise leaves from the Resort Plaza Shops at 115 S. 2nd St., with departures at 4:30, 5:30, 6:30 and 7:30 PM and extra times on some days.
Tickets are $30.50 for adults, $29.50 for seniors 55 and up and $15 for youth 6 to 12, and children 5 and under ride free.
Guests see more than 1.5 million lights from the water, then visit Santa and his elves at his waterfront toy workshop, where Santa speaks to each child by name.
The host is The Coeur d'Alene Resort.
The address is 115 S. 2nd St., Coeur d'Alene, ID 83814.
Cost: Adults $30.50; seniors 55 and up $29.50; youth 6 to 12 $15; children 5 and under free.

about: The City of Post Falls hosts its annual Winterfest at the City Hall Plaza, 408 N. Spokane St., on Friday, December 4, 2026, from 4 to 8 PM. Admission is free.
